protocol: Released chair pile and Bunny Pile proxy (NOT Iron Maiden). Five deterministic per-body ±10um position jitter seeds; same seed matched across modes. Released masses/inertia/friction, 4 substeps and 20 AVBD iterations. Uniform/curvature use released 4+1 collision params; dense uses1000 area-stratified fixed surface points/dynamic body against all other SDFs, one contact per active directed sample, no optimizer or manifold reduction. Not the paper 1000-optimized-seed baseline. Post-step kinetic energy; 10ms idle/frame.
